name: reCAPTCHA
description: Protect your website from spam and abuse while letting real people pass through with ease.
project_description:
Uses the free reCAPTCHA service from Google to help protect websites from spam and abuse. It's easy for humans to solve, but hard for “bots” and other malicious software to figure out.

 This module extends the CAPTCHA module . reCAPTCHA is built for security. Armed with state of the art technology, it always stays at the forefront of spam and abuse fighting trends. reCAPTCHA is on guard for you, so you can rest easy.

 Type of reCAPTCHA supported: 
 
 reCAPTCHA V2 
 Invisible reCAPTCHA ( work in progress ) 
 
 Alternatives 
 
 FriendlyCaptcha provides a European alternative and also has a free open source client included, if you don't need a subscription.
